record.question: When calamity __________ the family, he faced it boldly.
record.explanation: Befall is transitive happen to, so calamity befell the family. Befell is its past form and matches faced; fell does not directly take the family in this sense. Original printed question, exact option order and required context reviewed; independently worked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner key is asserted.
